description: This file defines the class tlExtTable, a helper class used to render and manage an Ext-JS-based table in a web application, including configuration, custom behaviour, and export functionalities.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A helper class for rendering EXT-JS tables with configurable behaviour, filters, sorting, grouping, and export options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table with columns, data, and configurations, setting up custom behaviours.

methods.name: addCustomBehaviour
methods.description: Registers custom rendering, sorting, or filtering behaviours for specific column types.

methods.name: buildContent
methods.description: Builds JSON-encoded table data for client-side rendering.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Generates JavaScript column configuration objects for the Ext-JS grid based on class properties.

methods.name: buildFields
methods.description: Creates JavaScript field definitions for the data store used by Ext-JS.

methods.name: buildCodeLabels
methods.description: Builds localized JavaScript objects for status, priority, and importance codes.

methods.name: renderHeadSection
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript code for initial table data, fields, and columns setup.

methods.name: renderCommonGlobals
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript code for global variables and labels used in tables.

methods.name: getGridSettings
methods.description: Returns JavaScript string for configuring grid appearance options.

methods.name: renderBodySection
methods.description: Outputs div container for the table.

methods.name: buildCfg
methods.description: Builds JavaScript for status code ordering configuration.

methods.name: getColumnIdxByName
methods.description: Retrieves index of a column in the columns array by its display name.

methods.name: setGroupByColumnName
methods.description: Sets the grouping column by column name.

methods.name: setSortByColumnName
methods.description: Sets the default sorting column by column name.

methods.name: buildStatusFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates filter options for status codes.

methods.name: buildPriorityFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates filter options for priority levels.

methods.name: buildImportanceFilterOptions
methods.description: Generates filter options for importance levels.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets image assets for the table, if applicable.

methods.name: getGridViewConfig
methods.description: Provides JavaScript configuration for grid view options, such as forceFit and grouping.

methods.name: getDisableUserJS
methods.description: Constructs JavaScript for an action column to disable users, with localization support.
